人の手はAIの手と打ち方が違うので、AIがまだ知らない局面を教えてくれます。届い: People play differently from the AI, so their games show it positions it has not learned yet. The positions from every game received are mixed into each round of self-play training. Moves after which the AI's own estimate dropped sharply (moves it had not seen coming) are collected in the weakness report (GitHub, Japanese) and used as clues to improve it.
